npcs.name: Razum-dar
npcs.greet: Raz is only a humble envoy of the Queen. Humble, handsome, and listening to everything you say. Sit, sit.

npcs.name: Sapiarch Ilmaril Senwe
npcs.greet: The Crystal Tower has kept the memory of the Aldmer since before the first Bosmer sang the first tree into shape. Do not touch the shelves.

relics.name: Veiled Heritance Cipher
relics.desc: A wax tablet of names and dates, written in a code that confuses Bosmer and Khajiit with livestock.

relics.name: Sea Viper War-Banner
relics.desc: Blue-green silk worked with a coiled serpent. The Maormer fly it when they mean to burn a town.

relics.name: Treaty of the Green
relics.desc: A pledge between Summerset and Valenwood, written on cured hide because no Bosmer will sign on paper.

relics.name: Queen Ayrenn's Gift
relics.desc: A carved box of Summerset glass holding a silver moon-sugar spoon. A gift for the Mane, and a promise.

ad_veil_lifted: Lord Varandil. Raz has eaten at his table. He has excellent wine and very ugly opinions about cats.
The Veiled Heritance thinks the Queen shames Summerset by shaking hands with Bosmer and Khajiit. They would rather the Dominion die pure than live together.
They are wrong, and now they are also short one lord. Good work, friend.
ad_crystal_tower: Light pours down through the Crystal Tower, splitting into colours on the floor. Altmer, Bosmer and Khajiit stand side by side beneath it, and not all of them look comfortable.
My mother's court said this alliance could not last a season. It has lasted because people like this one carried it across Tamriel on foot.
Kneel, and rise as my Hand. When I cannot be there, you will be.
Raz will be weeping now, in a very dignified way. Do not look.

quests.title: The Queen's Eyes
quests.offer: I want to serve the Dominion.
quests.pitch: Good, good. Raz has a small problem with large teeth. Someone on the Firsthold docks is passing messages to people who hate the Queen. Raz cannot be seen watching the docks; everyone knows Raz. You, nobody knows. Yet.
quests.desc: Razum-dar, a Khajiit who calls himself Queen Ayrenn's humble envoy, asked me to watch the Firsthold docks for a conspirator passing messages against the Queen.

objectives.text: Stop the messenger before he slips away
objectives.journal: The messenger tried to throw his tablet into the harbor. He threw it poorly.

objectives.reply: Ah. The Veiled Heritance. Raz hoped it was only smugglers. Smugglers you can bargain with. Welcome to the Queen's service, friend. Raz will try not to get you killed.

quests.outro: I caught a Veiled Heritance messenger on the Firsthold docks and gave his cipher to Razum-dar, who welcomed me into Queen Ayrenn's service.

consequence.summary: I caught a Veiled Heritance messenger on the Firsthold docks and gave his cipher to Razum-dar, who welcomed me into Queen Ayrenn's service.

quests.title: Beneath the Veil
quests.pitch: Raz broke it over breakfast. The Veiled Heritance meets in an old cellar in the hills west of here, and the man who leads them wears a silk mask and a very expensive ring. Go in. Bring Raz the ring, with or without the finger.
quests.desc: The cipher led Razum-dar to a Veiled Heritance meeting place in the hills west of Firsthold. He wants their masked leader stopped.

objectives.text: Unmask the leader of the cell
objectives.journal: Under the silk mask was Lord Varandil, a councillor of Firsthold. He spat that the Queen had sold her birthright to beasts. Then he stopped saying anything.

objectives.topic: The Silk Mask was Lord Varandil.
objectives.reply: Raz suspected. Raz hoped to be wrong.

choices.label: Some of his followers surrendered. They deserve a trial.
choices.reply: A trial. Yes, the Queen would like that. Raz will see they get one, and Raz will see it is public. Let Auridon hear what they believed.

choices.label: Hang the rest quietly. Fear will finish the job.
choices.reply: Hm. Effective. Also exactly what the Veiled Heritance would do. Raz will think about it. Raz will think very hard.

quests.outro: I unmasked the leader of a Veiled Heritance cell: Lord Varandil of Firsthold. The conspiracy is wounded, though Razum-dar doubts it is dead.

consequence.summary: I unmasked the leader of a Veiled Heritance cell: Lord Varandil of Firsthold. The conspiracy is wounded, though Razum-dar doubts it is dead.

quests.title: Sails off Vulkhel Guard
quests.desc: Maormer raiders from Pyandonea have landed on the Auridon shore near Vulkhel Guard. Razum-dar thinks the Veiled Heritance told them where the patrols would not be.

objectives.reply: Sea Vipers on the west shore, burning boats at Vulkhel Guard. Somebody told them the patrol was moved. Raz would like to know who, but first Raz would like the Maormer dead.

objectives.text: Drive the Maormer raiders back into the sea

objectives.journal: Captain Orilith called a wave onto the beach that took two of the town's boats with it. The third wave she called never came.

objectives.text: Bring the banner to Razum-dar in Firsthold
objectives.topic: The raid is broken. Here's their flag.
objectives.reply: Raz will hang it in the hall, upside down. The Maormer find that very rude. Now, you are going on a long trip. Raz hopes you like trees.

quests.outro: I broke a Maormer raid on Vulkhel Guard and took the Sea Vipers' war-banner. Razum-dar says my next task lies far from Summerset.

consequence.summary: I broke a Maormer raid on Vulkhel Guard and took the Sea Vipers' war-banner. Razum-dar says my next task lies far from Summerset.

quests.title: Treaty of the Green
quests.desc: Razum-dar has given me a treaty to carry to Elden Root in Valenwood. The Green Pact must agree to it, and spies of the Daggerfall Covenant would very much prefer that it never arrive.

objectives.text: Carry the treaty to Elden Root

objectives.topic: I bring a treaty from Queen Ayrenn.
objectives.reply: On hide, not paper. Someone in Summerset was listening, for once. But the Green does not sign for the Queen. It signs for the one who carries the treaty. Tell me why you carry it.

choices.label: Because Summerset needs the forest more than the forest needs Summerset.
choices.reply: True, and rarely said aloud by an outsider. The Green will remember that you said it.

choices.label: Because divided, all of us fall to the Covenant and the Pact.
choices.reply: A soldier's reason. Not wrong. The Green has buried a great many soldiers and kept their songs.

objectives.text: Hand the treaty to the Spinner
objectives.reply: It is sung, which is better. Go carefully. There are Bretons in the trees who were very interested in this treaty.

objectives.text: Ambush the Covenant spies on the road
objectives.journal: The Covenant spies carried a copy of my route, written in a Firsthold hand. Somebody in the Queen's own city is still talking.

quests.outro: Spinner Aerfin sang Valenwood's assent to Queen Ayrenn's treaty, and I killed the Covenant spies who had been waiting to stop it.

consequence.summary: Spinner Aerfin sang Valenwood's assent to Queen Ayrenn's treaty, and I killed the Covenant spies who had been waiting to stop it.

quests.title: The Mane's Blessing
quests.desc: With Valenwood bound to the Dominion, Queen Ayrenn wants Elsweyr's blessing as well. I am to carry her gift to the Mane in Riverhold.

objectives.text: Present the Queen's gift to the Mane
objectives.topic: Queen Ayrenn sends this, with her respect.
objectives.reply: A spoon for moon sugar, made by people who do not eat it. The Mane understands the meaning. But gifts are words. The Mane would see a deed.

objectives.text: Ask what deed the Mane requires
objectives.reply: Raiders from the Ebonheart Pact are burning sugar caravans on the road west of the city. Nords and Dunmer, far from home and very hungry. Make them less hungry, forever.

objectives.text: Destroy the Pact raiders on the caravan road

objectives.reply: Then the caravans will sing your name in their own way, which is mostly about the price of sugar. Tell your Queen: Elsweyr stands with the Dominion. The Mane will come to the Crystal Tower.

quests.outro: I carried Queen Ayrenn's gift to the Mane and cleared Pact raiders from the caravan road. Elsweyr has pledged to the Dominion, and the Mane will attend the ceremony at the Crystal Tower.

consequence.summary: I carried Queen Ayrenn's gift to the Mane and cleared Pact raiders from the caravan road. Elsweyr has pledged to the Dominion, and the Mane will attend the ceremony at the Crystal Tower.

quests.title: The Crystal Tower
quests.desc: Altmer, Bosmer and Khajiit will gather at the Crystal Tower to seal the Aldmeri Dominion before Queen Ayrenn. Sapiarch Ilmaril Senwe will keep the rite, and Razum-dar is certain the Veiled Heritance will not let the day pass quietly.

objectives.text: Speak with Sapiarch Ilmaril Senwe in Alinor
objectives.reply: You are here to stand in the right place and say nothing until spoken to. The rite is old and the Sapiarchs are older. Go to the Tower and wait by the eastern stair.

objectives.text: Stop the Veiled Heritance assassins at the stair
Kill the Veiled Heritance's last master
objectives.journal: The Veiled Hand had been a Sapiarch's acolyte. He had studied the Tower's stairs for years. He never thought someone might wait on them.

objectives.text: Return to the Sapiarch for the ceremony
objectives.topic: The stair is clear. The ceremony can begin.
objectives.reply: Then stand where I told you, and this time, kneel when the Queen looks at you.

quests.outro: I stopped the Veiled Heritance's last strike at the Crystal Tower. Before the gathered peoples of the Dominion, Queen Ayrenn named me her Hand.

consequence.summary: I stopped the Veiled Heritance's last strike at the Crystal Tower. Before the gathered peoples of the Dominion, Queen Ayrenn named me her Hand.
